note: Pooled outward centre speed of all MP VIIRS small-gap fire pairs after removing the edge-reach (pixel size), noise-coupling, view-angle and sensor-order terms (coefficients fitted on the other season half). Per-pair term: edge_term_by_pair.parquet (pair_row = pairs.parquet row; subtract edge_m from the clipped p_out). The night factor is large because v2 night was small; absolute night CI is ~8-12 m/h. Centre speed, not front speed.
